Admin.otaBookingProtocol: Channel Manager API (XML) or partner API
Admin.otaBookingNotes: Two-way sync of inventory, rates, and reservations. A separate rate-plan mapping layer is needed to ingest Booking.com's rate-plan structure (Genius / Mobile rates).
Admin.otaAgodaNotes: Given the high share of Asia-region guests, we plan automatic surcharge reflection during peak periods. Requires integration with Agoda's own hotel IDs and content API.
Admin.otaFooterNote: In production this is swapped for two-way sync via each OTA's channel manager (SiteMinder / TL-Lincoln, etc.) or for direct calls to each provider's partner API.
Admin.guestRegisterSubtitle: Guest records under the Housing Accommodation Business Act §8. Records name, nationality, contact, and occupation, retained for 3 years.
Admin.complianceTitle: Housing Accommodation Business Act (Minpaku Act) compliance notes
Admin.complianceItem8Title: §8 Duty to keep a guest register
Admin.complianceItem8Body: Record name, address, occupation, and stay dates, retained for 3 years. Passport numbers are also required for foreign-national guests.
Admin.complianceItem6Body: Verify identity in person or via "ICT-based methods." For the ICT method, having the guest present their passport on video or take a face photo, among others, is permitted.
Admin.complianceItem23Body: Up to 180 nights per year (April – next March). See the cap counter on the dashboard.
Admin.complianceReportBody: Every two months, report the number of nights, guests, and a breakdown by nationality. This sample substitutes a CSV export feature.
Admin.complianceFooter: * Before going live there are additional operational requirements such as notifying the local public health center, posting signage, and setting up a complaints contact. Consult a specialist for details.
Admin.idCheckOkTitle: ICT identity verification: ID image + face photo obtained
Admin.idUploadTitle: Upload an ID image for ICT identity verification (mock)
Admin.settingsSubtitle: Use this when you want to return the demo to its initial state.
Admin.settingsConfirmReset: This restores all sample data to its initial state (edits made during the demo to reservations, passcodes, messages, the guest register, etc. will be lost). Are you sure?
Admin.settingsResetSuccess: Sample data restored to its initial state
Admin.settingsResetIntro: The following slices revert to their seed defaults:
Admin.settingsResetItemReservations: Reservations (the demo set, including a near-overlapping booking)
Admin.settingsResetItemPolicies: Pricing rules / cancellation policy / reminder templates
Admin.settingsResetPreserved: The admin auth state and language selection are preserved.
Admin.capCounterNote: Housing Accommodation Business Act §2-3: a 180-night annual operating cap. Aggregated by fiscal year (April – next March).
Admin.occupancyDenominator: Computed against {rooms} rooms × {nights} days = {roomNights} room-nights as the denominator.
